import.title: Import your profile
import.lead: Start from what you already have. You review everything before it’s saved, and the file itself isn’t kept.

linkedin_zip.title: Your LinkedIn data export
linkedin_zip.description: The ZIP LinkedIn sends you from Settings, Data privacy, Get a copy of your data. Read here, without AI.

pdf.title: A PDF
pdf.description: Your CV, or your LinkedIn profile saved as a PDF. An AI model reads it.

text.title: Pasted text
text.description: Your CV or your profile, copied as text. An AI model reads it.

import.zipOnly: Ask LinkedIn for a copy of your data (Settings, Data privacy), then upload the ZIP it sends you. PDFs and pasted text need an AI model, which this Applicamp hasn’t set up.
import.zipHint: Up to 20 MB. Only your profile, positions, education, skills, languages, certifications, projects and main email are read.
import.pdfHint: Up to 8 MB and 30 pages, with real text (not a scan).
import.textLabel: Your CV or profile, as text

errors.invalid_upload: Choose a file, or paste some text, first.
errors.file_too_large: This file is too large: up to 20 MB for a ZIP, 8 MB for a PDF.
errors.text_too_long: This text is too long: up to 60,000 characters.
errors.not_a_zip: This isn’t a ZIP archive. Upload the ZIP LinkedIn sent you.
errors.archive_too_many_entries: This archive holds too many files to be a LinkedIn export.
errors.archive_entry_too_large: A file in this archive is too large to be part of a LinkedIn export.
errors.archive_too_large: This archive is too large once unpacked to be a LinkedIn export.
errors.archive_unsafe_path: This archive has a file stored outside it, so it wasn’t opened.
errors.not_a_pdf: This isn’t a PDF. Upload a PDF, or paste the text instead.
errors.pdf_unreadable: This PDF couldn’t be read. Try another file, or paste the text instead.
errors.pdf_too_many_pages: This PDF has more than 30 pages.
errors.pdf_no_text: This PDF has no text we can read (it may be a scan). Paste the text instead.
errors.nothing_found: Nothing to import was found in this. Check it’s the right file.
errors.ai_unavailable: Reading PDFs and text needs an AI model, which isn’t set up here. Import your LinkedIn export instead.
errors.ai_daily_limit_reached: You’ve reached today’s AI limit. Try again tomorrow, or import your LinkedIn export.
errors.ai_failed: The AI model couldn’t read this just now. Try again in a minute.

review.title: Review what was found
review.lead: Nothing is saved until you choose. Replace makes this your profile; Merge keeps yours as it is and adds only what’s new.
review.gone: This draft is no longer here: drafts last 24 hours.
review.droppedBody: They weren’t in the file, so we didn’t keep them. Nothing is ever made up.

placeholders.name: Add your name
placeholders.label: Add a headline
placeholders.summary: Add a few sentences about you

form.dateInvalid: Write a year (2021), a month (2021-03) or a day (2021-03-15).
form.dateHint: A year, or a year and a month.
form.saveFailed: Your change couldn’t be saved. Try again.

section.title: Goals
section.description: What you want next. Agents search, rank and tailor with these answers; change one and the next search uses it.
section.offerBody: Want to tell agents what you’re looking for? It’s a few short questions, one at a time. Skip any of them, and stop whenever you like.

interview.saveFailed: That answer couldn’t be saved. Try again, or skip it.

roles.label: Roles
roles.title: What roles do you want next?
roles.lead: Name them the way you would search for them.

work_mode.label: Work mode
work_mode.title: How do you want to work?
work_mode.empty: Say how you want to work

locations.label: Places

locations.empty: Add the places you can work from

relocate.label: Moving
relocate.title: Would you move for the right job?

cash_floor.label: Cash floor
cash_floor.title: What’s the least you’d take, before tax?

autonomy.lead: Applying and emailing always wait for your approval, whatever you pick.
autonomy.empty: Say how much agents may do

relocate.no: No, I’m staying where I am

find_only.title: Find jobs only
find_only.description: Agents search and rank. Anything else, you ask for.

prepare.title: Prepare applications
prepare.description: Agents also tailor your CV and draft cover letters and answers.

prepare_and_schedule.title: Prepare and schedule
prepare_and_schedule.description: Agents also draft replies to recruiters and suggest times. You still approve every send.
